name: 通义灵码
desc: Alibaba Cloud coding assistant, renamed Qoder in 2026
desc_zh: 阿里云编码助手，2026 年起更名 Qoder
solves: It plugs into VS Code, Visual Studio and the JetBrains editors instead of asking you to move to a new one.
solves_zh: 它装进 VS Code、Visual Studio 和 JetBrains 系编辑器里，不要求你换一个全新的环境。
best_for: Staying in the current IDE while a second opinion stays one keystroke away.
best_for_zh: 留在现在的编辑器里，同时多一个随时能问的帮手。
